svg.title: Governed robot memory: claim-specific failure and permitted reuse
svg.desc: A recorded failed grasp supports separately assessed claims: the completion claim is withdrawn; calibrated force evidence can support diagnosis or a counterexample; an approved approach segment can support scoped demonstration. The episode and provenance remain available for permitted audit and reassessment. Illustrative assessment outcomes, not experimental data. Figure 1 from Governed Memory for Physical AI, by Dr. Carsten Stöcker, Spherity GmbH. Copyright © 2026 Dr. Carsten Stöcker, Spherity GmbH. Licensed CC BY 4.0. PDF vector extraction with lettering converted to paths; content unchanged.
